scope: Solve one native bucket-indexed color with runtime bias mode
tolerance_reason: Existing Coulomb f32 tolerances, unchanged. Only impulse, velocity and cached-delta floats use tolerance; native tags, padding, untouched color ranges, uniforms and guard words remain exact.
preconditions: Native Rust tile, pose, velocity, parameter and batch layouts; monotone cumulative bucket ends within capacity
Writable velocity slots in each color are disjoint and cannot alias another endpoint read; zero inverse mass and inertia permit shared read-only static slots; successive colors execute in order
Valid finite active physics inputs and unit rotations; positive damping, nonnegative timestep/frequency, finite derived coefficients
Current color is a solved bucket; unsolved final-bucket contacts remain outside the dispatch
invariants: Runtime Mode uses Rust decode_bias_mode, including unknown nonzero values; fixed unbiased cached solve ignores Mode
Native RbdSimParams coefficients are computed by generated device code using Rust-exported constant bits
The selected bucket range crosses arbitrary tile/workgroup boundaries and preserves all other tile lanes
Each program stage keeps original buffers; no CPU graph or physics fallback occurs between dependent colors
Cached deltas are tagged with body IDs and zero padding, including empty manifolds
Endpoints with zero inverse mass and inverse inertia never write their velocity slot; signed zeros and padding are preserved exactly.
outside_scope: Full twist scene/runtime integration, fused scheduling optimizations, articulated multibodies, 2D and Ascend execution.
